newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fil-Estate unit to build condominiums.
newsitem.headline: Fil-Estate unit to build condominiums.

text.p: Fil-Estate Land Inc said on Friday a leasehold agreement entered into by its unit Fil-Estate Properties Inc (FEPI) and Subic Bay Waterfront Development Corp (SBWDC) had been approved by the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA).

The agreement paves the way for the construction of four luxury residential condominiums to be built under a joint venture agreement between FEPI and SBWDC, Fil-Estate vice president Michael Toledo told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Fil-Estate will take an 80 percent interest in the project, while the remaining will be held by SBWDC and SBMA.

"Based on the masterplan, the project will be adjacent to the waterways, the Subic Bay Marina Club, the retail/entertainment row similar to Pier 39 in San Francisco, the hotel and waterfront marina villas and the main commercial drive of the Subic complex," Toledo said.
Subic is a freeport area north of Manila.
